# Run journal: <campaign-id>

No runs recorded yet. Add entries in chronological order; retain failed/partial attempts.

## Entry format

### Round <NNN> — <purpose>

- Status: planned / running / completed / partial / failed / cancelled / analyzed.
- Parent round:
- Hypothesis and changed settings:
- Dataset/role hashes:
- Suite path and source commit:
- Run ID(s), execution/rule mode and evidence reference:
- Observed findings, exact denominators and critical regressions:
- Interpretation and uncertainty:
- Next decision: refine / retain both / prune / stop / final evaluation.
- Next settings and reason:
- Full round-record path:
- Author and timestamp:

Leave observation fields "not run" while planned. A later correction is a new dated note referencing the earlier entry, not an overwritten conclusion.
